div.h2: Nigeria Core PHC Terminology Service Capability
div.p: This narrative is a developer-facing summary of the computable Nigeria Core capability requirements for this actor and facility level. The computable CapabilityStatement remains authoritative.

Unless this CapabilityStatement narrows a resource capability, each listed resource follows the R4 interaction outcomes below. Failed interactions SHALL return a FHIR OperationOutcome with an appropriate HTTP 4xx or 5xx status.

description.value: Minimum computable FHIR requirements for the Nigeria Core Terminology Service role in primary health care facilities.

purpose.value:
Defines the computable Nigeria Core requirements for the Nigeria Core Terminology Service role in primary health care facilities. Supports coded data validation lookup and ValueSet expansion.
This CapabilityStatement supports implementation, procurement, vendor onboarding, SANDBOX FHIR configuration, interoperability testing, and automated conformance assessment. A deployed server SHALL expose only capabilities actually implemented by the deployment in its runtime /metadata response.

documentation.value:
Nigeria Core Nigeria Core Terminology Service requirements for primary health care facilities. Provides read search lookup expansion validation and terminology conformance functions.
Reference Policy: systems SHALL support literal FHIR references and logical identifier-based references. Same-server and same-Bundle relationships SHOULD use Reference.reference. Cross-platform relationships MAY additionally use Reference.identifier with stable national, programme, regulator-issued, or local identifiers. External absolute references are not assumed to be resolvable unless required by an exchange agreement or a more specific CapabilityStatement.
Search Policy: supported searches SHALL follow FHIR R4 semantics. Search success returns HTTP 200 with Bundle.type = searchset. Search failures SHALL return an appropriate HTTP 4xx/5xx response with OperationOutcome. Servers SHALL document required filters and SHALL NOT apply undocumented hidden filters.
Operation Policy: the referenced OperationDefinition is authoritative for scope, parameters, input types, output types, and cardinalities. Failed operations SHALL return an appropriate HTTP 4xx/5xx response with OperationOutcome.

description.value: Production systems SHALL authenticate and authorise access according to Nigeria Core security guidance and applicable national, programme, organisational, and regulatory policy. Access controls SHOULD consider user, role, organisation, facility, geography, purpose, consent, and data sensitivity. Communication over open networks SHALL protect confidentiality and integrity.
